exclusions: Raw Wood, Scrap, Cultist Gems, Gem of the Forest, pelts, meteor materials, and other ingredients are not standalone rows unless they are the crafted output.
Tablet upgrades are not rows because they upgrade existing blueprints rather than appear as distinct craftable output rows in the source table.
Guide-only thumbnails, placeholder images, and broad camp screenshots were rejected as row images.
Codes, events, gamepasses, badges, and platform metadata are outside this catalog.
blockers: Farm Plot cost has a source conflict: Fandom table says 20 Wood, while Fandom trivia says current cost is 10 Wood. Competitors checked so far support 20 Wood, but parent/in-game review is recommended before final public copy.
Tactical Shotgun and Thorn Body have Tool Workshop recipe rows that list ingredients followed by TBA. Dataset keeps the listed ingredients and marks both rows partial.
Flag effect/image come from a secondary item index because Fandom Crafting leaves the effect blank and has no image.

items.name: Map
items.effect: Shows a map with forest information and can be opened with M on PC or the map icon on mobile.

items.name: Supply Crate
items.effect: Lets players use flames and furniture in-game instead of setting them only from the lobby.

items.name: Old Bed
items.effect: Makes the day counter increase by +1.

items.name: Bunny Trap
items.effect: Can be placed near a bunny burrow to catch food, and can give 4 morsels if it uses a carrot.
items.limit: Can be crafted up to 10 times.

items.name: Crafting Bench 2
items.effect: Unlocks Tier 2 of the Crafting Bench.

items.name: Sun Dial
items.effect: Shows how much time is left until day or night in the top-right screen area.

items.name: Regular Bed
items.effect: Makes the day counter increase by +1.

items.name: Compass
items.effect: Shows the direction of the Fairy, missing children, and the direction the player is facing.

items.name: Farm Plot
items.effect: Grows crops automatically every two days.
items.limit: Can be crafted up to 20 times.
items.sourceNote: Fandom Crafting table lists 20 Wood. The same page trivia says Farm currently requires 10 Wood, so this cost needs parent review or in-game confirmation before public copy.
items.verificationNote: Cost conflict: Fandom Crafting table lists 20 Wood, while the same page trivia says the current Farm cost is 10 Wood.

items.name: Wood Rain Storage
items.effect: Keeps stored wood dry when it is placed inside.
items.limit: Can be placed more than once.

items.name: Shelf
items.effect: Stores other items neatly at camp.
items.limit: Can be placed more than once.

items.name: Log Wall
items.effect: Fortifies and protects the base with tall logs.
items.limit: Can be placed more than once.

items.name: Log Gate
items.effect: Creates an openable entry point for a log-wall base defense.
items.limit: Can be placed more than once.
items.sourceNote: Fandom Crafting gives the same defense description as Log Wall. Fandom Log Gate page adds that it is freely opened and closed.
items.imageStatus: local crafting image present from secondary item index

items.name: Bear Trap
items.effect: Can trap enemies and deal damage, and can also damage players.
items.limit: Can be crafted up to 8 times.

items.name: Crafting Bench 3
items.effect: Unlocks Tier 3 of the Crafting Bench.

items.name: Crock Pot
items.effect: Combines food into Stew. Berries cannot be put inside a Crock Pot.

items.name: Radar
items.effect: Detects key places in the forest by using Scrap.
items.sourceNote: Fandom Crafting row label is misspelled as Rader; image and common item name support Radar.

items.name: Boost Pad
items.effect: Gives a speed boost once activated and used.

items.name: Biofuel Processor
items.effect: Turns logs, pelts, and some food into Biofuel.

items.name: Torch
items.effect: Expands the safe zone by a small amount.
items.limit: Can be placed up to 10 times.

items.name: Good Bed
items.effect: Makes the day counter increase by +1.

items.name: Lightning Rod
items.effect: Attracts lightning so it does not strike the player.
items.limit: Can be placed more than once.

items.name: Flag
items.effect: Marks important locations for navigation.
items.sourceNote: Fandom Crafting lists the recipe cost but leaves description blank. The secondary item index supplies the marker effect and image; its material text conflicts with Fandom, so cost follows Fandom Crafting.
items.imageStatus: local crafting image present from secondary item index
items.verificationNote: Effect and image come from a secondary item index; recipe cost follows Fandom Crafting because secondary material text conflicts.

items.name: Crafting Bench Tier 4
items.effect: Unlocks Tier 4 of the Crafting Bench.

items.name: Ammo Crate
items.effect: Allows players to buy ammo with Scrap.

items.name: Oil Drill
items.effect: Drills for oil barrels periodically.

items.name: Giant Bed
items.effect: Makes the day counter increase by +1.

items.name: Teleporter
items.effect: Allows teleporting to anywhere on the map when two or more Teleporters are placed.
items.limit: Requires two or more Teleporters to work. Can be placed more than once.

items.name: Crafting Bench Tier 5
items.costSummary: 50 Wood, 50 Scrap, 1 Gem of the Forest
items.effect: Unlocks Tier 5 of the Crafting Bench.

items.name: Respawn Capsule
items.costSummary: 40 Wood, 40 Scrap, 1 Gem of the Forest
items.effect: After charging, automatically respawns the most recent dead player inside it.

items.name: Temporal Accelerometer
items.costSummary: 40 Wood, 40 Scrap, 1 Gem of the Forest
items.effect: Skips the next night once charged.

items.name: Weather Machine
items.costSummary: 40 Wood, 40 Scrap, 1 Gem of the Forest
items.effect: After charging, stops rain and thunderstorms for the next three days.

items.name: Recycler
items.costSummary: 40 Wood, 40 Scrap, 1 Gem of the Forest
items.effect: Converts Gem of the Forest into Cultist Gems and Cultist Gems into Scrap.
items.sourceNote: Fandom Crafting has the effect and cost but no clean image. Secondary item index confirms Recycler as a crafting machine.
items.imageStatus: local crafting image present from secondary item index

items.name: Freezer
items.effect: Stored food cleanly when it was available.
items.unlockRequirement: Removed row; Fandom lists Bench T2 as the old requirement.

items.name: Flower Pot
items.effect: Holds one Valentine flower at camp, giving the team a permanent campsite buff from that flower.
items.unlockRequirement: Valentines event craftable; Fandom lists Bench T2.

items.name: Spooky Crockpot
items.effect: Works like the normal Crock Pot and also cooks Halloween foods during the event.

items.name: Thanksgiving Crock Pot
items.effect: Works like the normal Crock Pot and also cooks Thanksgiving foods during the event.

items.name: Hammer
items.effect: Moves structures that are normally unmovable.
items.limit: The Hammer price does not increase no matter how many are made.

items.name: Bandage
items.effect: Heals the player and revives dead players.
items.limit: Each Bandage craft increases the cost of each ingredient by 1. Maximum scaling is not listed.

items.name: Mammoth Helmet
items.effect: Reduces damage taken and keeps the player warm.
items.unlockRequirement: Assemble the Tool Workshop anvil when the Snow Biome version is available.
items.sourceNote: Tool Workshop page says Infernal Helmet is formerly the Mammoth Helmet, but also lists Mammoth Helmet as only craftable when Snow Biome spawns.
items.verificationNote: Tool Workshop source says Infernal Helmet was formerly Mammoth Helmet, but also lists Mammoth Helmet as craftable when Snow Biome spawns.

items.name: Infernal Helmet
items.effect: Reduces damage taken and grants immunity to regular burning or lava effects according to source pages.
items.unlockRequirement: Assemble the Tool Workshop anvil when the Volcanic Biome version is available.

items.effect: Cuts down trees and can damage entities.
